title: Koṭṭhiko
text: 2 Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko yena Bhagavā || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || Yaṃ kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Kiñca Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ || || 4 Cakkhuṃ kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || Rupā aniccā tatra te chando pahātabbo || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || Cakkhusamphasso anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo || Yam pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 5-6 Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || 7 Jivhā aniccā tatra te chando pahātabbo || Rasā aniccā || Jivhāviññāṇaṃ || Jivhāsamphasso || Yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 8-9 Kāyo || || Mano anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo || Dhammā aniccā || Manoviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ || manosamphasso || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || 10 Yam kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || || [page 146] 146 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 162. 2
